notes.title: Game Release as of July 13th!
notes.notes:
Thank you for checking out the game! Did you know you can get the Episode 0 demo on Steam? It's available now on the store page. For those that don't know, it's the third save file in the demo that is [i]The Customer is Always Right[/i]! ... Otherwise, you can always play the preceding store of [i]The Customer is Always Right![/i], known as the "[i]Memory of Thoth[/i]," a mysterious game on the laptop in your room. 
 
Adventures await, my friend!
